description: A source-structured visualization of the Mitchell Institute high-value airborne asset protection concept.

citations.locator: Figures 6-8; HVAA protection lines of effort

assumptions: This starter scenario preserves the report's three lines of effort but uses abstract actors and fictional presentation geography.
Displayed timing is for explanation only and does not represent real alert cycles, launch timelines or aircraft performance.
Threat behavior and engagement outcomes are not simulated.
Additional actors and routes should be added only when supported by cited research.

phases.title: Pulse Support
phases.narrative: Frame the first line of effort: CCA and crewed aircraft support high-value airborne assets during major strike pulses.

phases.title: Ambush Alert
phases.narrative: Frame the second line of effort: reactive waves between strike pulses intended to complicate threats to high-value airborne assets.

phases.title: Decoy Operations
phases.narrative: Frame the third line of effort: decoy, ISR and electronic-attack effects used between pulses to keep defenses uncertain and help identify targets.
